# Contact-mode graph (generated by sim/getup_modes.py)

Touch threshold 5 mm; every mode additionally requires quasi-static feasibility of the touching set (statics LP, peak |tau|/tau_max <= 0.8). Regions are the G0 shell regions of `getup_schema.REGIONS`.

## Nodes

| key | mode | required touching (each any-of group) | may also touch | must be off the floor | trunk orientation | extra | class / level | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SUPINE | supine {back} | {lower_back,upper_trunk} | ALL | - | chest_z >= 0.7 (chest up) | - | LYING_UP / 0 | lying on the back; limbs anywhere (start state, F3 q_supine_settled) |
| SIDE | side-lying {right side} | {R_upper_arm,lower_back,pelvis,upper_trunk} | ALL | - | left_z >= 0.7 (body +y up, i.e. right side down) | - | LYING_SIDE / 0 | lying on the right flank (left mirror image omitted: model is L/R symmetric) |
| PRONE | prone {chest} | {lower_back,upper_trunk} | ALL | - | chest_z <= -0.7 (chest down) | - | LYING_DOWN / 0 | lying on the chest; limbs anywhere |
| SIT | long-sit {pelvis} | {pelvis} | L_foot,L_forearm,L_hand,L_knee,L_shank,L_thigh,R_foot,R_forearm,R_hand,R_knee,R_shank,R_thigh | L_upper_arm,R_upper_arm,head,lower_back,upper_trunk | head_z >= 0.7 (trunk within 45 deg of vertical) | - | UPRIGHT / 1 | sitting on the butt, back off the floor (the F3 P1_head_up target) |
| QUAD | quadruped {hands+knees} | {L_hand}; {R_hand}; {L_knee}; {R_knee} | L_foot,L_shank,R_foot,R_shank | L_forearm,L_thigh,L_upper_arm,R_forearm,R_thigh,R_upper_arm,head,lower_back,pelvis,upper_trunk | chest_z <= -0.5 (chest facing the floor) | - | PITCHED / 1 | on hands and knees (shins / foot backs may rest on the floor); trunk, pelvis, head off |
| HF | plantigrade {hands+feet} | {L_hand}; {R_hand}; {L_foot}; {R_foot} | - | L_forearm,L_knee,L_shank,L_thigh,L_upper_arm,R_forearm,R_knee,R_shank,R_thigh,R_upper_arm,head,lower_back,pelvis,upper_trunk | chest_z <= -0.2 (chest facing the floor, pitched) | - | PITCHED / 1 | on hands and feet only ('bear' / plantigrade) |
| SQUAT | deep squat {feet} | {L_foot}; {R_foot} | - | L_forearm,L_hand,L_knee,L_shank,L_thigh,L_upper_arm,R_forearm,R_hand,R_knee,R_shank,R_thigh,R_upper_arm,head,lower_back,pelvis,upper_trunk | head_z >= 0.5 (trunk within 60 deg of vertical) | base z <= 0.26 m | UPRIGHT / 2 | feet only, pelvis low |
| STAND | standing {feet} | {L_foot}; {R_foot} | - | L_forearm,L_hand,L_knee,L_shank,L_thigh,L_upper_arm,R_forearm,R_hand,R_knee,R_shank,R_thigh,R_upper_arm,head,lower_back,pelvis,upper_trunk | head_z >= 0.94 (tilt <= 20 deg) | base z >= 0.32 m (0.85 Z_stand) | UPRIGHT / 2 | goal: feet only, upright, base at >= 85 % standing height (F3 P4 criterion) |
